_comment: NVIDIA AI Blueprint cards — the grounding corpus for SELECT + PLAN (D8). Each card's title+description is embedded for use-case matching; the services list + description ground the architecture plan. Sourced from build.nvidia.com/blueprints and github.com/NVIDIA-AI-Blueprints. Full notebooks (for GENERATE grounding) exist for a subset; the rest ground on the card + the NVIDIA Skills catalog (Phase 2C). Service ids map to data/nvidia.ts.

blueprints.title: Enterprise RAG Pipeline
blueprints.description: Production retrieval-augmented generation over private enterprise documents. Multimodal ingestion of text, tables, charts and PDFs; embedding, hybrid dense+sparse retrieval and reranking; grounded LLM generation with citations; optional safety guardrails. For knowledge assistants, copilots, internal search, and document question-answering over proprietary corpora.

blueprints.title: Financial Fraud Detection
blueprints.domain: financial services, tabular ML, anomaly detection
blueprints.description: GPU-accelerated real-time fraud detection over tabular transaction data. Feature engineering and gradient-boosted / graph models on RAPIDS, optimized inference, low-latency scoring of streaming transactions. For credit-card fraud, payment anomaly detection, transaction monitoring, and risk scoring.

blueprints.title: AI-Q Research Agent
blueprints.domain: agentic AI, enterprise research, deep search
blueprints.description: Customizable enterprise research agent that connects to your data, reasons over it, and returns cited answers or long-form reports. Two-tier intent routing between fast shallow lookups and a multi-agent deep-research loop (orchestrator, planner, researcher). For enterprise search, competitive analysis, due diligence, and knowledge synthesis.

blueprints.title: AI Virtual Assistant for Customer Service
blueprints.description: AI-driven virtual assistant that streamlines customer service with automated, context-aware responses grounded in company knowledge. Retrieval over support docs, conversation memory, safety guardrails, multi-turn dialog. For customer support copilots, help desks, and automated ticket resolution.

blueprints.title: Video Search and Summarization (VSS)
blueprints.description: GPU-accelerated vision agents for video analytics: search, summarize and answer questions over long-form video. Frame extraction, vision-language understanding, temporal reasoning, and natural-language querying of video content. For surveillance review, media analysis, sports, and industrial video inspection.

blueprints.title: PDF to Podcast
blueprints.description: Transforms PDF documents into engaging two-host podcast-style audio. Multimodal extraction of text, tables and figures; grounded script generation; natural text-to-speech with distinct voices. For turning reports, papers and filings into on-the-go audio content.

blueprints.title: Retail Shopping Assistant
blueprints.description: Multi-agent shopping advisor with text and image-based product search, personalized recommendations via agentic RAG, complex multi-item task handling, and shopping-cart management. For e-commerce copilots, conversational shopping, visual product discovery, and personalized cross-sell.

blueprints.title: Retail Catalog Enrichment
blueprints.description: GenAI system that transforms raw product images into comprehensive structured catalog data — attributes, descriptions, tags. Vision-language extraction and generation at catalog scale. For e-commerce catalog automation, product data enrichment, and listing generation.

blueprints.title: Multi-Agent Intelligent Warehouse
blueprints.description: Multi-agent system for warehouse and supply-chain operations: routing, slotting, inventory and task coordination using GPU-accelerated optimization. For warehouse management, order fulfillment, route optimization, and logistics planning.

blueprints.title: LLM Router
blueprints.description: Routes each LLM request to the best-fit model for the task, balancing quality, latency and cost. Classifier-driven routing across a pool of models. For multi-model serving, cost-quality optimization, and adaptive inference.

blueprints.title: BioNeMo Virtual Screening
blueprints.domain: drug discovery, life sciences, molecular AI
blueprints.description: Generative virtual screening for drug discovery: protein structure prediction, molecular generation, and binding affinity prediction to accelerate hit identification. For pharmaceutical R&D, lead optimization, and computational chemistry workflows.

blueprints.title: cuFOLIO Portfolio Optimization
blueprints.description: GPU-accelerated portfolio optimization for investment workflows: large-scale mean-variance and constrained optimization, risk modeling, and rebalancing. For asset management, quantitative finance, and portfolio construction.

blueprints.title: Quantitative Signal Discovery Agent
blueprints.domain: financial services, quantitative research, agentic AI
blueprints.description: Agentic system that discovers and validates quantitative trading signals over financial time-series and alternative data. GPU-accelerated data processing with agent-driven hypothesis generation and backtesting. For quant research, alpha discovery, and systematic strategy development.

blueprints.title: AI Model Distillation for Financial Data
blueprints.description: Distill large models into smaller, faster domain-specialized models for financial data, preserving accuracy while cutting inference cost. Knowledge distillation, fine-tuning and compression. For deploying efficient finance-specific LLMs at scale.

blueprints.title: Real-Time Voice Agent
blueprints.description: Low-latency real-time voice agent built on Nemotron: speech-to-text, grounded LLM reasoning, guardrails, and text-to-speech for natural spoken conversation. For voice assistants, call-center automation, and telephony agents.

blueprints.title: Digital Human / Avatar Assistant
blueprints.domain: digital human, avatar, multimodal customer service
blueprints.description: Interactive digital-human avatar combining speech, animation and grounded LLM dialog for face-to-face customer engagement. Real-time avatar rendering with retrieval-grounded responses and guardrails. For virtual concierges, kiosks, branded assistants, and interactive customer service.
